title: Slavey - Wikipedia
text: The Slavey (also Awokanak, Slave, and South Slavey) are a First Nations group of Indigenous peoples in Canada. They speak the Slavey language, a part of the Athabaskan languages.

title: Dene Tha Language (Denetha, Dene That, Slavey, Slavi, Slave)
text: Dené Tha is an Athabaskan language of Northern Canada. Historically the Dene Tha have been known as "Slavey" or "Slave" Indians, but due to negative associations with the English word "slave" this name is not preferred by most Dene Tha people.

title: Slavey, South | Ethnologue Free
text: South Slavey is an endangered indigenous language of Canada. It belongs to the Eyak-Athabaskan language family and is part of the Slave macrolanguage. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by adults only.

title: South Slavey – TIPs
text: South Slavey (xsl) is a(n) Athabaskan-Eyak-Tlingit language of Canada, marked as shifting.In Dëne Súline the native term for “lamb” directly translated as “the young one of an evil little caribou.” To avoid the negative connotation, a loan word from the neighboring South Slavey was used.
